beats: Every demo clip I made before was filmed against a fake stand-in page -- it looked real, but proved nothing.
The actual site could be broken, and the demo still played.
A Playwright script now drives a real browser at the live site and clicks through the real feature.
If it records, the feature actually works -- the clip doubles as a smoke test.
It's retimed to 0.67x afterward, just enough to make the real thing feel calm on camera.
